title: These are easy to use.  6 ml, isn't very thick for dehydrated foods
text:
These are easy to use. 6 ml, isn't very thick for dehydrated foods. The 6 ml is good for items that don't have sharp edges. Dehydrated food items, tend to be sharp and would not do well in these bags. I don't have the knowledge to review the oxygen absorbers, they are small. I like the zipper, it makes it convenient to close once opened. I have a sealer similar to other vacuum sealers, but it can vacuum and seal mylar bags. These would work great for freezer use or items that don't have sharp edges. I would do a trail and error with different foods before putting large investments in them. The labels are great!

Although, this is a vine item for me, I actually use mylar and other vacuum seal bags.

Items are not free as we have to pay the cost of whatever income tax bracket we are in.
